purpose: Consistent first-run layout references. Implemented with shared React components.

screens.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the first reference into one high-fidelity Fable onboarding screen, 1440x900. The first image is the authoritative style reference; the second is the approved Fable mark. Preserve that exact original mark, warm near-white #fbfbfa canvas, restrained normal-weight Inter-like type, muted gray secondary text, soft diffuse shadows and fine lines. This is a real desktop app screen, not a marketing poster. Replace the conversation layout with a quiet centered first-run flow. No sidebar, no avatars, no illustrations, no ornamental cards, no macOS traffic lights. Content is a compact 360px-wide column centered slightly above the vertical midpoint; original Fable mark appears small, 40px, above the title. Heading 30px normal-medium weight; description 14px gray; black primary button 46px high, 12px corners; subtle secondary text actions. Three tiny step indicators sit at the bottom center. Keep ample whitespace and a coherent brand. Screen 1 of 3, account sign-in. Exact text: 'Welcome to Fable', 'Sign in or create an account to get started.', 'Continue with Google' with a small Google symbol in the black button, 'Continue with email' as a quiet text action, 'Privacy' as a tiny footer text link. First step indicator active. No Back button, no extra promises, no email form yet.
